title: Recursive circuit tail
statement: For each nonnegative integer $m$, a circuit tail with $m$ available inputs is either an output layer specified by a finite set of input indices, or a non-output layer specified by a list of finite sets of input indices, followed by a circuit tail whose number of available inputs equals the length of that list.
hypotheses_covered: The input count $m$ is a nonnegative integer
An output layer has a finite set of indices among the $m$ inputs
A non-output layer has a list of finite sets of indices among the $m$ inputs
The remaining tail has as many available inputs as the list has entries
